description: The robot clenches its gripper into a fist with a quick wrist motion, then raises its arm sharply upwards in a triumphant victory gesture, pausing at the top to emphasize the victory.
The robot extends its arm upward in a controlled motion, emphasizes the upward thrust with a sharp wrist accent, and completes the gesture with a crisp wrist rotation, mimicking a fist pump.
The robot performs a focused bicep flex by sharply lifting the forearm using the wrist and elbow, emphasizing the localized muscle contraction.
The robot performs a shrug by lifting its shoulder upward and backward, conveying a sense of uncertainty or 'I don't know,' starting from its initial fixed pose.
The robot reaches up with its arm, hesitates near the head, and then performs a subtle scratch with a confused wrist shake, conveying a sense of uncertainty.
The robot abruptly lowers its arm in a diagonal arc, simulating a facepalm gesture to express frustration or embarrassment.
The robot transitions from a back-facing pose to point its arm toward its own body, emphasizing the gesture with a brief hold to reinforce the 'point self' cue.
The robot extends its arm forward in a controlled motion, pointing directly towards the viewer with a slight downward wrist tilt for emphasis.
The robot extends its arm forward and gently beckons by making a series of rhythmic wrist beats along the vertical axis, inviting someone to come closer.
The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing outward, creating a clear 'stop' gesture.
The robot extends its arm to the left and gently pats its stomach using rhythmic wrist movements in a side-to-side manner.
The robot uses rapid, side-to-side wrist flicks to mimic the action of fanning itself, expressing discomfort from heat.

The robot gently lifts its arm slightly higher, then dips it down in a relaxed arc, rotating the wrist to cover its face as if yawning or shielding its eyes, and holds the pose briefly to convey sleepiness.

The robot adjusts its arm slightly to tap its temple, symbolizing thoughtful reflection or deep consideration.
The robot slowly repositions its arm toward the temple area, then executes a fast circular motion with the wrist to symbolize madness, holding briefly at the end.
The robot leans slightly forward by extending its shoulder and tilting its elbow, conveying a sense of focused interest. The motion ends with a brief pause to emphasize attentiveness.
The robot slowly dips its arm forward and downward, uses a wrist rotation to position the hand near its mouth, and holds the pose to mimic the gesture of covering the mouth in surprise or shock.
The robot raises its arm upwards in a celebratory 'cheers' gesture, holding the pose briefly to convey a toast.
The robot extends its arm upward in a friendly gesture, opens its palm, and waits invitingly for a high-five.
The robot extends its arm horizontally with a slight upward angle, mimicking a high-five gesture, and gently rotates its wrist to present the palm outwards, ready for interaction.
The robot retracts its arm slightly backward, then extends it forward again in a controlled manner, inviting a fist bump interaction.
The robot repositions its arm toward its back, then performs a series of deliberate, soothing patting motions with the wrist to convey self-reassurance.
The robot draws a smooth circle in the air twice, starting from the horizontal fixed pose, with a brief pause between repetitions to emphasize the repeated action.
The robot performs a rapid side-to-side 'throat cut' motion using the shoulder joint, followed by a sharp upward jerk and freeze to emphasize the 'stop.'
The robot performs a sharp, dismissive chin flick by extending its arm back and executing a precise wrist flick in the upward-forward direction.
The robot reacts to a loud noise by quickly bringing its arm inward in an arc, adjusting the gripper to cover its ears.
The robot raises its arm in a controlled motion, bends the elbow to bring the hand to the forehead, and holds the position briefly to execute a formal salute.
The robot performs a focused search motion by panning its wrist horizontally (left and right) while subtly adjusting its elbow to vary the reach, giving the impression of a thorough visual scan.
The robot yields by smoothly rotating its arm laterally and pausing to indicate readiness to give way.
The robot extends its arm forward in a gentle gesture, then slightly shifts to the side to indicate a request to turn.
The robot extends its arm smoothly forward and slightly upward, holding the position to guide the viewer's attention in a specific direction.
The robot extends its arm outward to establish a protective barrier, then subtly adjusts its position to create a shield-like stance.
The robot extends its arm forward and slightly upward, indicating direction, then gently taps forward with the wrist to emphasize the escorting gesture.
The robot gently tilts its palm upward in a controlled, deliberate motion, pausing briefly to request clarification.
The robot extends its arm forward, rotates its wrist to orient the palm downward, and then traces a small, slow arc in the xz-plane to signal a 'slow down' request.
The robot's arm, starting in a horizontal front-facing position, performs a single, swift circular sweep using wrist rotation, symbolizing increased speed or momentum.
The robot extends its arm backward, rotates gently to display the palm, and holds the position with a waiting posture.
The robot extends its arm gently forward in a polite manner, then performs a small downward dip with the wrist to convey a soft decline or gentle push.
The robot extends its arm forward in a controlled, deliberate manner, holding the final position to signify firm acceptance.

The robot performs a hesitant half-reach forward, extending the shoulder slightly and inclining the wrist tentatively, as if cautiously acknowledging or accepting something but holding back from a full commitment.
The robot extends its arm forward and then smoothly retracts it backward, symbolizing the cancellation or withdrawal of a previous offer.
The robot acknowledges a condition with a small, deliberate wrist gesture, pauses to consider, and then reaches out to proceed.
The robot extends its arm further downward in a controlled manner, pauses briefly to emphasize deliberation, and then uses a sharp wrist accent to simulate a decisive press.
The robot gently extends its arm with a smooth shoulder and wrist pull, inviting attention back to the speaker.
The robot emphasizes a point by performing a sharp, decisive downward dip with the shoulder, holding briefly at the bottom to reinforce the gesture.
The robot hesitates by slightly extending its arm forward and then suspends the hand in mid-air, conveying a sense of uncertainty or indecision.
The robot extends its arm forward smoothly, mimicking a supportive gesture as if ready to catch or stabilize someone falling.
The robot performs a subtle wrist-based 'yes' nod by pivoting vertically twice with a brief pause between movements, maintaining the extended arm position from the fixed start pose.
The robot performs a firm 'no' gesture by shaking its gripper from side to side using lateral wrist movements.
The robot makes a series of small lateral wrist movements to mimic human air quotes, pausing briefly between each movement to emphasize the gesture.
The robot gently retracts its arm toward its body, rotates it inward, and holds the pose as if embracing itself for comfort.
The robot probes restlessly forward and side-to-side as if exploring or seeking something, then tilts to one side in a curious manner.
The robot extends its arm slightly upward while opening the gripper to mimic the gesture of raising a finger, holding the pose momentarily to emphasize the action.
The robot extends its arm slightly forward, maintaining a vertical grip, and performs a gentle side-to-side swaying motion with the wrist to signal 'shh'.

The robot arcs its arm inward toward the center of its body using the shoulder joint, simulates rubbing the arm by rotating the wrist, and repeats this motion a few times to convey the action of warming up cold arms.
The robot retracts its extended left arm by moving the shoulder inward, crossing it over the body to assume a defensive posture.
The robot performs a graceful preparatory lift, followed by a coupled backward-up motion, aligns its wrist, and concludes with a palms-together gesture in a respectful 'thank you' manner.
The robot quickly raises its arm above the head in a gesture of surrender, holding it steady for a moment to reinforce the message.
The robot swings its arm inward from the right in a graceful arc, opens the gripper, and holds the pose to convey a warm and inviting welcome.

The robot begins with its arm extended upward and performs a controlled, two-stage stretch by extending both the shoulder and elbow joints further upward, pausing briefly midway to emphasize the action.
The robot crosses its arm over the body in a swift, deliberate motion to signal disagreement, then releases the arm back to its original position.
The robot performs a sharp, forceful downward throw motion, combined with a subtle sideways wrist flick to convey frustration.
The robot lowers its arm in a deliberate, respectful motion, simulating a submission or offering gesture by dipping the shoulder and extending the elbow with a gentle hold at the end.
The robot extends its arm directly upward in a controlled, confident motion, reaching a dominant high-open pose and holding it firmly.
The robot begins with its arm extended horizontally to the left, then gracefully lowers it in an arc as if bowing in apology, holding the lowered position with humility.
The robot extends its arm abruptly forward in a sharp, decisive snap from its upward starting position.
The robot executes a single, smooth circular motion around the wrist, tracing an arc in the xz-plane to symbolize a reset or retry action.
The robot swiftly drops its grip and pivots away, signaling abandonment of the current action.
The robot prepares for action by smoothly raising its arm upward and holding the elevated position briefly to signal readiness.
The robot hesitates by making a small, uncertain wrist motion and then pauses deliberately in the new position, conveying doubt or caution.
The robot's arm extends smoothly outward from its initial position, symbolizing expansion or growth.
The robot performs a gentle, lateral sweep of the arm to convey a sense of uncertainty, hesitating slightly after each swing.
The robot interrupts decisively by thrusting forward and then shifting laterally, creating a sense of urgency and intrusion into personal space.
The robot performs a soft interruption by gently tapping its wrist in the upward direction, mimicking a subtle acknowledgment or nudge.
The robot extends its arm to the right and uses its gripper to simulate containing or pinching space by quickly closing the gripper and holding the position briefly.
The robot extends its arm forward horizontally to open up space, then lifts its wrist upward, symbolizing the action of expanding or clearing an area.

The robot arm pulls inward along the x-axis to simulate compressing space, accompanied by a subtle wrist rotation to enhance the compression effect, and ends with a brief hold at the compressed position.
The robot extends its arm horizontally and performs a controlled, rhythmic tilting motion of the wrist along the x-axis, mimicking the balancing action of a scale.
The robot performs a deliberate push-pull motion by alternately extending and retracting its arm along the x-axis, maintaining a vertical grip orientation throughout.
The robot shifts its weight forward by extending the arm slightly forward and downward, mimicking a human's natural weight transfer.
The robot shifts its weight backward by retracting the arm slightly and lifting it upwards, mimicking a human's posture during a weight shift.
The robot prepares to rotate away by dipping its arm slightly inward, then smoothly shifting its arm laterally to the side, mimicking a torso rotation away from the viewer.
The robot smoothly rotates its arm laterally toward the viewer, holding the final position briefly to convey acknowledgment or invitation.
The robot leans its arm slightly to one side, conveying a sense of doubt, and then twists its wrist subtly, emphasizing internal uncertainty.
The robot subtly extends its arm backward and upward, simulating an open and confident posture akin to expanding the chest.
The robot's arm smoothly arcs backward with a slight lift, mimicking a surprised reaction, and holds briefly at the peak to emphasize the gesture.
The robot subtly shifts its gaze by moving its arm in a smooth lateral arc, simulating the action of looking away from the viewer.
